Benjamin J. McMichael is the Jere L. Beasley Professor of Law and Director of Interdisciplinary Legal Studies at the University of Alabama School of Law.
:::

::: {.about-grid}
::: {.about-main}
## Research

His work examines health care regulation, professional licensing, medical markets, and health policy through empirical legal research.
